newsitem.title: FRANCE: Council of Europe MPs to discuss Albania election.
newsitem.headline: Council of Europe MPs to discuss Albania election.

text.p: A three-member delegation from the Council of Europe's parliamentary committee will visit lawless Albania this week to discuss preparations for a general election there in June, the council said on Wednesday.
On its agenda will be the country's new coalition government and all political infrastructure problems for the early poll which was called by President Sali Berisha.

The visit, on Friday and Saturday, will be the second by a council parliamentary delegation in a month. Albania joined the 40-state council, which monitors democracy and human rights in Europe, in 1995.
Scores of people have been killed in Albania where looting and banditry flared last month after an uprising over the collapse of high-risk savings schemes.
The United Nations has agreed to send a force of about 5,000 to protect aid shipments to the lawless state.
